headline: Up to 10% off Qatar Airways flights with Visa cards
description: Save up to 10% on Business Comfort and Economy Convenience fares (up to 5% on Classic fares) when you book on Qatar Airways' Visa page and pay in full with an India-issued Visa card. Travel until 31 Mar 2027.
how_to_redeem:
1. Go to qatarairways.com/apacvisa
2. Search your route and pick a fare showing the discount
3. Enter promo code APVISA26
4. Pay the full amount with your Visa card
terms: Book by 31 Dec 2026 for travel until 31 Mar 2027; selected fare classes and destinations only; discount on base fare only, not taxes or surcharges; blackout dates apply; not combinable with other promotions; Visa cards issued in eligible APAC markets including India
verified_note: ✓ Official Visa India offer page (checked 6 Oct 2026)

headline: 10% off (up to ₹7500) on 2+ night villa stays with Visa cards
description: Book at least 2 nights at select SaffronStays villas and get 10% off the stay, up to 7500 rupees, when you pay with a Visa card.
how_to_redeem:
1. Pick a villa on saffronstays.com for 2 or more nights
2. Apply code ADNETO10 at checkout
3. Pay with your Visa card
terms: Minimum 2 nights; select villas only; accommodation only, meals charged extra; blackout 20 Dec to 2 Jan; not combinable with other discounts or reward points; bookings on SaffronStays only; Visa cards
verified_note: ✓ Official Visa India offer page (checked 6 Oct 2026)

headline: Flat 20% off full-body massages with Visa cards
description: Get 20% off a 60 or 90 minute Swedish, Deep Tissue or Indian Abhyanga full-body massage booked on Tattva Spa's website and paid with a Visa card.
how_to_redeem:
1. Book a full-body massage on tattvaspa.com at least 24 hours ahead
2. Apply code TTVVISAOFFER20 at checkout
3. Pay with your Visa card
terms: Monday to Thursday only; website bookings made 24+ hours ahead; not at LT Group or airport outlets; blackout on major holidays; prices exclude taxes; once per user; not combinable; Visa cards only
verified_note: ✓ Official Visa India offer page (checked 6 Oct 2026)

headline: 20% off making charges on gold, diamond and silver jewellery with Visa (in-store)
description: Get 20% off making charges (on the barcode rate) for gold, diamond and silver jewellery at Joyalukkas showrooms in India when you pay with a Visa card. You must show your employee ID card or the Visa offer message received by email or SMS at billing.
how_to_redeem:
1. Visit a Joyalukkas showroom in India
2. At billing, show your employee ID or the Visa offer email or SMS and quote VISAJOYB2B20
3. Pay with your Visa card
terms: In-store only at Joyalukkas showrooms in India; not on gold or silver coins and bars; requires employee ID or the offer communication; once per user; not combinable with other offers; Visa cards only
verified_note: ✓ Official Visa India offer page (checked 6 Oct 2026)

headline: 20% off IHG hotel stays with Visa cards (no code)
description: Visa cardholders in India get at least 20% off the Best Flexible Rate at participating IHG hotels (InterContinental, Crowne Plaza, Holiday Inn and more) across India and Asia Pacific. Free IHG One Rewards membership required.
how_to_redeem:
1. Join IHG One Rewards (free)
2. Open the IHG offer from Visa's offer page and book through that link
3. Pay with your India-issued Visa card
terms: Book and stay by 31 Dec 2026; participating IHG hotels in India and Asia Pacific; off the Best Flexible Rate; IHG One Rewards membership needed; hotel may ask for proof of Visa card at check-in
verified_note: ✓ Official Visa India offer page (checked 6 Oct 2026)

headline: Up to 10% cashback as Booking.com wallet credit with Visa cards (no code)
description: Book a stay through Booking.com's Visa India page and pay with a Visa credit or debit card to earn up to 10% back as Booking.com wallet credit, capped at 200 US dollars per reservation.
how_to_redeem:
1. Open booking.com/visaIN
2. Book your stay and pay with a Visa credit or debit card
3. Use a Booking.com account with the same email as the booking
4. Wallet credit arrives 64 or more days after checkout
terms: Stays only; book through booking.com/visaIN; credit capped at 200 US dollars per reservation; credit only usable at properties that accept online payment; not cash
verified_note: ✓ Official Visa India offer page (checked 6 Oct 2026)

headline: Up to 30% off DragonPass Student Travel Bundle with Visa cards (no code)
description: Students going abroad save up to 30% on DragonPass's Student Travel Bundle (lounge access, fast track, eSIM and a limo voucher, valid 1 year and refundable) when paying with any Visa debit, credit or prepaid card.
how_to_redeem:
1. Open the DragonPass offer from Visa's offer page
2. Choose the Student Travel Bundle
3. Pay with a Visa debit, credit or prepaid card
terms: Student Travel Bundle only; any Visa debit, credit or prepaid card; DragonPass terms apply
verified_note: ✓ Official Visa India offer page (checked 6 Oct 2026)

headline: 10% extra ClassPass credits + up to 25% fewer credits per class with Visa (no code)
description: Visa cardholders get 10% additional ClassPass credits on their subscription and need up to 25% fewer credits to book selected studios and classes. Useful only where ClassPass has studios in your city.
how_to_redeem:
1. Open the ClassPass offer from Visa's offer page
2. Start or update your ClassPass subscription with your Visa card
3. Book selected studios and classes with your credits
terms: Paid ClassPass subscription with a Visa card; reduced credits on selected studios and classes only; ClassPass program terms apply; availability depends on your city
verified_note: ✓ Official Visa India offer page (checked 6 Oct 2026)
